people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Edrei
people.line: Amorite city defeated by Moses and the Israelites

people.name: Og
people.line: King of Bashan, defeated by Israel

translations.web: They turned and went up by the way of Bashan. Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
translations.bsb: Then they turned and went up the road to Bashan, and Og king of Bashan and his whole army came out to meet them in battle at Edrei.
translations.kjv: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.
translations.asv: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
